text_block_list.text:
With the Kikuka Sho over, Кинг Хало
must face
reality as the crowd hollers for
Спешл Уик and
Сэйун Скай.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало laments her loss and her
failure to be
recognized, and doubts if
she's really first-rate.
But then,
Kawakami Princess and a few others

offer their encouragement.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Knowing I've been with her the whole
time, King
Halo rests her head on my
shoulder. We remain
that way until her
tears stop flowing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Following my suggestion, she resolves to
not
strive for the approval of others but
to become
her own version of first-rate.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
